messages:
maria: FYI KZ Labs pinged about a surprise Dedicated burst charge on their March invoice. They say they didn’t run any large jobs that day. Can someone pull usage detail?

jamie: Thanks — I’ll pull the per-host logs and the dedupe of job IDs. Do we have the invoice line id?

maria: billing-bot posted it in the ticket but here’s what KZ quoted:  `Invoice# 2026-03-05 — DEDICATED-BURST — $3,450.00` They attached a csv of timestamps.

billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice 2026-03-05 generated for account kzlabs (acct_6789). Line items:
```
DEDICATED_COMMIT_MONTHLY  1  $12,000.00
DEDICATED_BURST_USAGE     1  $3,450.00  (2026-03-02 00:00 - 2026-03-02 04:00)
TAX                       1  $1,100.00
```

ajay: Looping in @linda from CS — can you confirm whether KZ sent any internal change notices? If not, we should consider a temporary hold on the charge while we reconcile. :eyes:

linda: KZ support rep says only normal dev traffic. They provided an app logs export showing steady req/s but nothing that matches a burst. I raised a support ticket asking for the workload IDs.

jamie: I pulled the Serving runtime logs for that slot. There's a short-lived surge tied to a misrouted batch job from another tenant (we have a partial routing rule collision that night). Attached snippet: 
```
2026-03-02T00:12:34Z  host-34  request_id=abc123  model=redwood-7b  seq_len=2048  tokens=12000
2026-03-02T00:12:35Z  host-34  request_id=abc124  model=redwood-7b  seq_len=3072  tokens=18000
```
This explains the high token count. It looks like burst was real but not from kzlabs.

maria: Can we trace the tenant id from those request_ids? If it's another customer we need to isolate and apply SLA/billing correction. Also we should check if routing fallback should have been prevented by the reserved capacity policy.

ajay: I can confirm request_id abc123 belongs to acct_1122 (internal partner test). That's on us. We should issue a credit to KZ and bill acct_1122 for the burst.

maria: Proposed remediation: refund full burst charge to kzlabs, create inter-account charge to acct_1122, and add a $0 discretionary credit to KZ for goodwill since this caused extra churn. Approve?

jamie: Approve from my side. Also suggest we push a config fix to the smart routing rules so tenant isolation is stricter for Dedicated pools.

ajay: Approve. I’ll draft the billing adjustment and reissue invoice lines.

maria: Filing the adjustment now. Credit memo created: CM-2026-03-KZ-01 for $3,450.00. Will post update in support ticket and CC KZ rep. I’ll also escalate to infra for routing fix. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Action completed: credit memo CM-2026-03-KZ-01 issued, new invoice 2026-03-05-v2 generated (burst line removed).

linda: Thanks team — KZ confirmed receipt and appreciates quick turnaround. Marking ticket resolved from CS side.

maria: Leaving a follow-up to billing ops to ensure acct_1122 receives chargeback for the burst. Also create an internal postmortem to avoid repeat.

jamie: Noted — I’ll own the postmortem and include timeline + fix path.

ajay: Thanks everyone.
